_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or counted from names a quote lists.

years.basis: years the Texas pilot advances in phases over

projects.basis: proposals selected for the federal pilot program

states.basis: states the eight selected projects span

launch_order.basis: Texas's place in the order of launches under the program

partners.basis: industry partners the FAA's selection names for Texas

cities.basis: cities the Texas project's regional flights connect

capabilities.basis: capabilities Merlin says it demonstrated, counted from c26's own list
names: dynamic autonomous in-flight re-planning and threat avoidance

caravans.basis: Cessna Caravans fitted with autonomous flight technology at AFW by their makers' accounts, one each in c32 (Merlin) and c36 (Joby's J208)

phase_one_passengers.basis: passengers the initial flights carry, from 'will not carry passengers'

joby_start_day.basis: first day of Joby's North Texas flight campaign, September

joby_end_day.basis: last day of Joby's North Texas flight campaign, September

joby_campaign_days.basis: days in the campaign, end minus start plus one, inclusive

joby_facility_sqft.basis: square feet of the facility Joby leased at Perot Field

cert_stage.basis: the stage of FAA type certification Joby says it is in

service_year_reported.basis: the air taxi service year Dallas Innovates reports, reported only

selection_day.basis: March day the FAA announced the selections

record_cells.basis: release by question cells on the record table, three releases by three questions

record_cells_yes.basis: cells where a release says it: only Merlin's, and only in a photo caption

releases.basis: releases the record table reads: TxDOT's (c1), the FAA's launch release (c2), Merlin's (c25)

schedule_days.basis: days in three years counted from September 10th, 2026, by the calendar

elapsed_days.basis: days from the September 10th kickoff to this deck's date, October 8th, 2026

runway_m.basis: the drawn runway's length, a drawing rule and not a claim

runway_m_per_year.basis: metres of drawn runway per year of the schedule, runway_m over years

plane_m.basis: how far down the drawn runway the plane stands tonight, runway_m times elapsed_days over schedule_days, to 0.1 m

elapsed_pct.basis: share of the schedule elapsed tonight, percent to 0.1
